claim: Patchline awards artifact badges only from gate-backed evidence: reusable, available, functional, and reproducible badges must each link to regenerated public-code outputs and concrete acceptance criteria.

badges.label: artifact
criteria: Public repository contains reviewer documentation, specs, scripts, and gates.

No production credentials or private datasets are required.

criteria: Focused gate rebuilds a public-code capstone session.
The session reports ranked risks, generated artifacts, and rejected bad output.
Generated evidence includes metrics, taxonomy, claims, limitations, figures, and case studies.

criteria: Reviewer roles and expected outputs are generated as JSON and Markdown.
